messages:
emma: 🚨 seeing a sudden spike in 5xx and client timeouts against hosted inference in us-east-1. 5xx rate ~8x above baseline since ~09:12 UTC. Opening this thread to coordinate.

javier: ack. pulling gateway logs and sps dashboards now. any customer-facing alerts yet?

priya: Support bot just pushed a ticket digest — 14 active tickets referencing `generate` timeouts and `502` responses in the last 20m. Linking here: <https://support.internal/tickets?q=us-east-1%20502>.

ops-bot: [system] anomaly detector: increased error rate detected for route `/v1/generate` across hosts hvc-*-us-east. Alert ID: A-2067-err.

javier: quick glance at gateway: connection pool exhaustion showing on api-gateway-03. backend error mix: `upstream_timeout` and `5xx` from inference pods. past deploy?

mika: there was a model-variant rollout 09:05 UTC to `gpt-open-3b-q4f16` in us-east. Canary passed, but throughput patterns differed. Reverting is an option.

emma: plan: 1) stop rollout 2) pin traffic to the previous variant for us-east 3) enable fallback routing to `gpt-open-3b-quant` for tails 4) scale up dedicated pool temporarily. Anyone object?

lara: +1. Also we should notify customers on status page and Slack #support-ops. I'll draft a short blurb.

javier: rolling back canary now. command: ```kubectl -n inference set image deploy/gpt-open-3b gpt=open-3b:v20260119``` will revert. executing.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] rollback started by javier at 09:26 UTC.

javier: rollback complete on us-east canary, routing toggled back to `v20260119`. Confirming metric re-eval.

emma: priya, support-bot - can you push a temporary webhook to route new requests to fallback quantized model for requests with latency>1.5s? We want to reduce customer error rate quickly.

priya: done. Added failover rule in routing policy: if p95>1200ms or backend 5xx rate>2% route small % (10%) to quant fallback.

support-bot: [support-bot] posted status: "Investigating increased 5xx/timeouts in us-east affecting hosted inference; mitigation in progress." <https://status.redwood/incident/2067004321> :warning:

gwen: seeing degraded but improving p95 now (from ~2.1s to ~1.0s) after rollback+fallback. Errors trending down.

mika: reading inference pod logs — KV cache spikes and OOM-slice messages around 09:04-09:10 during canary. snippet: ```2026-03-15T09:07:12Z inference[pid=4212] WARN kvcache: miss-rate spike=0.78; mem-evict=1; forward-timeout=1200ms```

emma: that suggests the new variant increases cache pressure -> higher tail latencies -> gateway timeouts. For now mitigation is good. We'll keep rollback in place and schedule a controlled re-eval.

javier: escalating to infra: need to temporarily increase node pool min from 6->10 in us-east to avoid connection pool exhaustion while we run diagnostics. Doing `terraform apply` now.

ops-bot: [system] autoscaler request submitted by javier.

priya: customer list: three major customers reported production errors (acct: cleverchat, ledgerly, note.ai). I've opened pro-active outreach tickets and set priority P1 for affected accounts.

support-bot: [support-bot] pushed templated email to affected customers: "We've detected an issue causing timeouts for inference in us-east. Mitigation is underway and routing has been adjusted. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

lara: action for product: schedule a regression evaluation for model-variant `gpt-open-3b-q4f16` against our standard perf suite and tail-latency tests before any re-rollout.

mika: I've captured a repro script and perf harness commands: ```# repro load
ab -n 5000 -c 50 -T 'application/json' -p request.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` plus attached `request.json` used for the failing pattern. Will upload to the incident artifacts bucket.

emma: good. we'll keep incident open until error rate back to baseline and the scaling changes are stable. Next steps for postmortem & action items:
- owner: mika -> upload full log bundle + repro harness (due EOD)
- owner: infra (javier) -> revert pool size after stabilization and document autoscaler thresholds (due 48h)
- owner: product (lara) -> create canary perf checklist including KV-cache mem profiling before variant rollout (due 72h)
- owner: runtime (priYA) -> add alert for kvcache-miss-rate >0.5 and link to runbook (due 48h)

priya: tiny correction: that's me (priya) on runtime tasks. noted. adding runbook item now.

javier: infra note: rolling increase completed. nodes added; we'll monitor.

gwen: tracking metrics: current 5xx rate back down to baseline ~0.2% and p95 stable ~450ms. marking mitigation success.

emma: thanks all. I'll turn this into a short follow-up postmortem template and assign the action items. Please add any missing owners now.

mika: adding detailed perf graphs and flame profiles to the doc bucket. will ping when uploaded.

support-bot: [support-bot] posting final P1 notifications to affected customers that mitigation completed and that a follow-up PM will come with root cause and compensation options.

emma: closing ops thread for now, leaving incident open for the postmortem items. Tagging @lara and @mika as primary authors for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
